paired_failure_states.sampling: Final attempted state and last executable predecessor of every failed episode; outcome-conditioned diagnostic set.

yaw_rate_mask_posthoc_sensitivity.note: Only frozen network first-layer column11 masked at selected diagnostic states; true yaw rate and control generation unchanged. No retraining or closed-loop outcome claim.

feature_shift.note: Closed-loop selected candidates vs training all feasible candidates: descriptive and selection-conditioned, not a test of causation. Rigid translation/heading are excluded from the representation.

first_executed_control_divergence.note: Posthoc analysis on original diagnostic maps. Controllers see exactly the same state and history until first differing executed command. This isolates selection difference at the branch, not its independent causal effect on downstream outcomes.

interpretation_constraints: Failure states were selected by outcome, so margins here do not estimate population risk.
Alternative schedules share identical states/history but downstream closed-loop consequences are not replayed in this comparison.
Counterfactual numerical error holds state/command fixed; it does not imply corrected integrators alone improve mission outcomes.
Feature-range comparisons are descriptive, include selected-candidate bias, and do not establish covariate shift as failure cause.
